snippet.title: The Greatest Sign of Immaturity? Not Sharing Your Dino Nuggets
snippet.description:
Example play through of Finish Each Others Sandwiches (Round 1 of 4), available now at https://www.airheadgames.com.

🥪 About Finish Each Others Sandwiches
Seeking all psychics! Prove you and your crew are in sync.

Work together to climb the scoreboard and impress the Sandwich Spirits by matching answers across four rounds: Quick Bites, Snack Attack, Same Order, and The Whole Enchilada. Each round has its own twist, but the goal stays the same: the more your minds align, the more points you earn.

Every now and then, you'll swear someone reached into your brain and finished your… sandwich.

🎈 About Airhead Games
Airhead Games are quick, multiplayer party games that never play the same. Your dynamic host, Poppy, makes every game feel deeply personal by calling out players by name, riffing on answers, and weaving your group into the game. It's endless fun for your Twitch stream, team ice breaker, or friendly game night.
